name: Bonnie J. Coronado
office: Lawndale School District, Governing Board Member, Trustee Area No. 1

items.text: Bonnie J. Coronado is a trustee on the Lawndale Elementary School District Governing Board, representing Trustee Area 1. She has served on the board since 2013.
